items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I remember one wonderful tenor, an Italian tenor, he would do bits from 'La Tasca'... I'll never forget how he used to sing 'Softly as the Morning Sunrise'

ctx.x: Tell us about that. That was in Chicago -- the Villa DeNice.

Yes, it was like fairyland out there in the suburbs of Chicago. They had an artiifical lake and a lagoon, and little streams flowing in the back with gondoliers singing, just like in Venice, Italy. And the show was all European acts -- like adaggio dancers and South American acts and European type acts. The singers were all clasically oriented; they would do -- I remember one wonderful tenor, an Italian tenor, he would do bits from 'La Tasca', the opera, you know, little arias andthen he would do certain popular…
